Five files use `QueryCell` from `apps/web/lib/QueryCell.tsx`. Each one imports it through the `@lib/QueryCell` alias or a relative path:

- `apps/web/components/apps/CalendarListContainer.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/apps/installation/EventTypeConferencingAppSettings.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/modules/apps/installed/[category]/installed-category-view.tsx` imports it from `@lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/EditLocationDialog.tsx` imports it from `../../lib/QueryCell` and renders `<QueryCell>`.
- `apps/web/components/dialog/__tests__/EditLocationDialog.test.tsx` is the test file. It imports `QueryCell` and mocks the module with `vi.mock("../../../lib/QueryCell", …)`.

`packages/platform/atoms/selected-calendars/wrappers/SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx` also uses a `QueryCell`. It imports a separate copy from `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell` (`packages/trpc/components/QueryCell.tsx`), so I left it out. That copy has the same imports as the web one, but I only read its first lines and didn't confirm the rest is identical.
